from pathlib import Path
import re
paths = [Path('docs/philosophy.md'), Path('docs/README.md'), *Path('docs/adrs').glob('000*.md')]
checked = 0
for path in paths:
    for target in re.findall(r'\]\(([^)]+)\)', path.read_text()):
        if '://' in target:
            continue
        name, _, anchor = target.partition('#')
        dest = path.parent / name if name else path
        assert dest.is_file(), (path, target)
        if anchor:
            headings = [re.sub(r'[^\w\- ]', '', line.lstrip('#').strip().lower()).replace(' ', '-') for line in dest.read_text().splitlines() if line.startswith('#')]
            assert anchor in headings, (path, target)
        checked += 1
print(f'Validated {checked} local documentation links and anchors.')
